runner.policy: One cold subject process per operation, no warmup, one sample; complete output validated before reporting. Startup, integrity hashing and owned PDF reopen are included.

host.cpu: Apple M4, 4 performance and 6 efficiency cores
host.placement: Automatic OS scheduling, normal priority, no affinity override
host.qualificationLimit: Concurrent host workloads and memory pressure; these are completed cold-process observations, not a stable throughput ranking or portable time/memory guarantee.

pdf.textBoundary: Independent extraction preserves stored characters. Whitespace and visual reading order differ from stored logical text; not a byte-identical extraction claim.

reproduction.readRender: Load the complete document, project Reader pages, render each page at default native DPI, validate page count and hash every returned RGBA raster.
reproduction.searchablePdf: Load the complete document, convert all pages with default ToPdfDocumentResult, validate source report page/text counts, save, reopen with PdfReadDocument and extract text. Independently reopen with Poppler and pypdf, check every scan image and physical page size.
reproduction.memory: macOS /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size measures the whole subject process in bytes, separate from runner-managed allocations.
